chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام: A man shot at game while he was in ihram, and broke its foreleg or hind leg, then it went off on its way and he did not know what became of it. He said: “Its expiation is upon him.”
I said: Then if he sees it afterward grazing and walking? He said: “A quarter of its value is upon him.”

key_terms.فِدَاؤُهُ: its required expiation or compensatory payment
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram during hajj or 'umrah

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a person in ihram injures game but the animal survives?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim who injures game during ihram. If the animal disappears and its outcome is unknown, full compensation is due; but if it is later seen grazing and walking, only a quarter of its value is due.
